note: Every date is normal data (the replay season the model was evaluated on), so a date on which the rule fires is a false positive. Regular season only; the data has no playoffs. Opening windows use the opening reference (ADR-0017).
insufficient_note: dates with fewer than min_rows rows in the window report `insufficient`: no PSI, no verdict, and they count as neither a false positive nor a pass

chosen.rule: HOLD when at least 3 features have PSI >= 0.15; the smallest candidate with zero false positives on every season position

sensitivity.shift_rule: each shifted feature moved up by half its reference q10-q90 range

reasons: 3 features at or above PSI 0.15 (ast_mean_last10, pts_mean_last10, reb_mean_last10); calibrated rule ((this calibration))
1 feature(s) at or above PSI 0.15 (pts_mean_last10), below the 3-feature rule
